The baby’s name, sex and exact date of birth have not been publicly disclosed. Foxx, who is already father to two daughters, Corinne, 32, and Anelise, 18, previously spoke about becoming a father again at his age. During an interview with E! News in August, the actor admitted that he initially had reservations about welcoming another child. “Being my age, I was a little on the fence,” he said, before explaining how meeting veteran actor Al Pacino, who welcomed a child in his eighties, helped put him at ease. Foxx and Huckstepp were first romantically linked in 2023 and reportedly experienced a brief separation in January 2025 before being spotted together again. The couple confirmed they were expecting their first child together in May 2026. The new arrival makes Foxx a father of three, adding another chapter to his family life.
